name: namht-spec-ui
description: Point-and-click UI over the namht-* Spec Kit skills for non-technical roles (PM/SM). Runs Claude Code under the hood.

namhtSpecUi.claudePath.description: Path to the Claude Code CLI executable.

namhtSpecUi.extraArgs.description: Extra args passed to `claude -p`. Default `bypassPermissions` lets skills run the tools they need headlessly (node for the map/PDF, npm/npx/jest for build & tests, gh, curl) — otherwise those Bash commands show up as 'error' because a headless run can't answer an approval prompt. The git-guard hook STILL blocks dangerous/remote git even in this mode (verified). Prefer prompts? Set this to ["--permission-mode","acceptEdits"] — but then map/build/test commands will fail with 'error' in this panel; use the ⚡ Interactive button (a real terminal) for those instead.

namhtSpecUi.usdToVnd.description: Approx VND per USD, shown next to the USD cost. Adjust to your rate; set 0 to hide VND.

namhtSpecUi.model.description: DEFAULT model pre-selected in each form's Model dropdown (passed as `claude --model`). You can override it per run and per follow-up in the panel. 'sonnet' is ~5x cheaper than Opus for read-only Q&A/planning at great quality; 'haiku' is cheapest for simple lookups; 'opus' for the hardest code tasks; empty = your Claude default.
